name: Missing or substituted item on same-day delivery
description: An item on a same-day delivery order was not delivered, or was replaced without the member's approval.
lifecycle_note: Closure: picker accuracy logged against the delivery partner; substitution-without-approval counted toward the partner's service-level review.

name: Damaged or spoiled bulk or perishable goods
description: Fresh, frozen or bulk goods arrived spoiled, crushed or leaking.
lifecycle_note: Closure: no return of perishables; item recorded as shrink with the cause (cold chain, handling, pack damage) so loss is attributed, not just refunded.

name: Pickup order not ready, partially filled or cancelled
description: Curbside or in-club pickup was late, incomplete, or cancelled after the hold window.
lifecycle_note: Closure: late-ready and out-of-stock events feed the club's pick-rate and inventory accuracy scorecards; cancelled orders are restocked the same day.

name: Coupon not applied or price adjustment
description: A clipped digital coupon did not apply at checkout, or the member asks for a price adjustment after a price drop.
lifecycle_note: Closure: coupon-application failures are reported to the digital coupon team with the coupon id; no inventory action.

name: Membership renewal or fee refund
description: The membership auto-renewed unexpectedly or the member asks for the annual fee back.
lifecycle_note: Closure: retention first. A refund closes the membership; the reply states what is lost (gas discount, rewards) before the member decides.

name: Return eligibility (category exceptions)
description: Can this item still be returned, given the category window and the house-brand guarantee?
lifecycle_note: Closure: returned goods dispositioned at the club (restock, open-box, vendor return); gift cards and final-sale items never re-enter inventory.

name: Agent-placed order gone wrong (quantity or pack size)
description: A personal AI agent ordered the wrong quantity or pack size versus what the member asked for.
lifecycle_note: Closure: unopened cases returned to stock; the agent fingerprint's drift record updates in Umpyr Check so the next order from that agent is scored with this history.

name: Duplicate charge or pre-authorization hold
description: The member sees two charges or a pending hold larger than the purchase.
lifecycle_note: Closure: true duplicates are reversed through the processor and logged for reconciliation; holds are explained with the release window, not refunded.
